title: The Player Booklet
lede: A write-in booklet for each player: character-creation prompts, lined journal pages to fill as your character unfolds, and a character sheet at the front and the back. One per player per session; print it, fold it, make it yours.
count: Sixteen pages. Pick any page to read it up close.
